questions.explanation_english: Automated plagiarism software cannot independently confirm academic dishonesty; qualitative human judgment is necessary to interpret similarity reports. questions.explanation_english: Resolving intellectual property infringement claims follows a four-step legal procedure. First, administrators receive a formal copyright violation notice from the rightsholder. Second, technical teams perform preliminary verification and temporarily disable access to contested online material. Third, an internal investigation notifies the individual who uploaded the content. Finally, the matter achieves resolution through license verification, permanent content removal, or valid fair use application.
